Dish: GF Refined Sugar Free Paleo Carrot Cake Breakfast Cookies with almond flour cinnamon ginger nutmeg almond butter coconut oil coconut sugar vanilla eggs & shredded carrot
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature or warm in the microwave for 10–15 seconds. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days or refrigerate for up to 1 week. Freeze individually wrapped for up to 1 month.

Dish: Paleo Butter Pecan Banana Muffins with almond flour flax seed tapioca flour cinnamon banana eggs coconut sugar butter vanilla & pecans
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature or warm in the microwave for 15–20 seconds. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days or refrigerate for up to 5 days.

Dish: Pecan Cinnamon Roll Granola with oats coconut pecans sunflower seeds pumpkin seeds cinnamon salt raisins vanilla pecan butter & maple syrup
Instructions: Enjoy at room temperature — no reheating needed. Serve over yogurt or with milk. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

Dish: Egg Muffin Cups with turkey bacon broccoli & cheddar cheese
Instructions: Reheat in the microwave for 45–60 seconds or in the oven at 325°F for 8–10 minutes until heated through. Store refrigerated for up to 4 days.

Dish: Spinach Artichoke Hummus with chickpeas tahini lemon garlic olive oil salt artichokes & spinach
Instructions: Serve chilled or at room temperature — no reheating needed. Stir well before serving. Store refrigerated with plastic wrap pressed directly on the surface. Best enjoyed within 4–5 days.

Dish: Spicy Chipotle Hummus with chickpeas tahini lemon garlic salt olive oil & chipotle peppers
Instructions: Serve chilled or at room temperature — no reheating needed. Stir well before serving. Store refrigerated with plastic wrap pressed directly on the surface. Best enjoyed within 4–5 days.

Dish: Vegetarian Tortilla Soup with tomatoes onion cumin oregano garlic black beans corn cilantro cotija cheese & crispy tortilla strips
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally and heat for 8–10 minutes until warmed through. Add tortilla strips and cotija cheese just before serving to maintain texture. Store refrigerated for up to 4 days.

Dish: Thai Coconut Curry Chicken Soup with garlic onion ginger lemon grass red curry paste coconut milk shiitake mushrooms chicken lime cilantro & scallions
Instructions: Pour into a saucepan over medium heat. Stir occasionally and heat for 8–10 minutes until warmed through. Do not boil — gentle heat preserves the coconut milk. Garnish with fresh cilantro and scallions just before serving. Store refrigerated for up to 4 days.

Dish: Popcorn Chicken with roasted baby potatoes
Instructions: Reheat popcorn chicken in the oven at 400°F on a baking sheet for 8–10 minutes until re-crisped — avoid the microwave to maintain texture. Reheat roasted baby potatoes alongside on the same pan or in a skillet with a drizzle of olive oil for 5–7 minutes. Served with peas & carrots: reheat in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Steak Fajitas with onions peppers shredded cheese guacamole sour cream & tortillas
Instructions: Reheat steak slices and peppers & onions together in a skillet over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes until warmed through. Warm tortillas in a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side. Serve with shredded cheese guacamole and sour cream on the side. Served with peas & carrots: reheat in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Chicken Parmesan with pasta & marinara sauce
Instructions: Reheat chicken parmesan in the oven at 375°F on a baking sheet for 12–15 minutes until heated through and cheese is bubbly. Reheat pasta and marinara separately in a saucepan over medium-low heat or microwave with a splash of water for 1–2 minutes. Served with peas & carrots: reheat in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Pepperoni & Mozzarella Hot Pockets
Instructions: Reheat in the oven at 375°F on a baking sheet for 12–15 minutes until heated through and crust is golden. Or microwave for 60–90 seconds — note the crust will be softer. Let rest 1–2 minutes before eating as filling will be very hot. Served with peas & carrots: reheat in the microwave for 1–2 minutes.

Dish: Honey Gochujang Shrimp Bowl with sticky rice cucumber salad shredded cabbage & edamame
Instructions: Reheat shrimp in a skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until just warmed through — avoid overcooking. Reheat sticky rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 60–90 seconds. Assemble bowl with cucumber salad shredded cabbage and edamame cold or at room temperature. Drizzle any extra sauce over top just before serving.

Dish: Balsamic Chicken Rice Bowl with cherry tomatoes mozzarella pearls basil over rice with balsamic glaze
Instructions: Reheat chicken in a skillet over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes per side until warmed through. Reheat rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 60–90 seconds. Assemble bowl with cherry tomatoes mozzarella pearls and fresh basil. Drizzle balsamic glaze over top just before serving.

Dish: Lentil Farro Salad with cherry tomatoes cucumber red peppers scallions parsley arugula & a herby lemon vinaigrette
Instructions: Serve chilled or at room temperature — no reheating needed. Toss well before serving. Dress just before eating to keep the arugula fresh. Best enjoyed within 3–4 days.

Dish: Spicy Thai Peanut Quinoa Salad with edamame carrots red peppers red cabbage scallions Thai basil cilantro roasted peanuts & a spicy peanut sauce
Instructions: Serve chilled or at room temperature — no reheating needed. Toss well before serving and drizzle peanut sauce over top just before eating. Best enjoyed within 3–4 days.

Dish: Miso Maple Salmon over black rice & garlicky broccolini
Instructions: Reheat salmon in the oven at 275°F on a foil-covered baking sheet for 10–12 minutes until just warmed through — low heat preserves the glaze and prevents drying out. Reheat black rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 60–90 seconds. Reheat broccolini in a skillet over medium heat with a drizzle of olive oil for 2–3 minutes.

Dish: Pepperoncini Feta Turkey Meatballs over garlic zaatar rice tzatziki pickled onions & sliced cucumber
Instructions: Reheat meatballs in a skillet over medium heat for 3–4 minutes turning occasionally until warmed through. Reheat garlic zaatar rice in the microwave with a damp paper towel on top for 60–90 seconds. Assemble with tzatziki pickled onions and sliced cucumber served cold or at room temperature alongside.

Dish: Pan Seared Pork Chops with sweet apple & caramelized onions over mashed potatoes & garlicky green beans
Instructions: Reheat pork chops in a skillet over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes per side until warmed through — avoid high heat to prevent drying out. Warm the apple and caramelized onion topping in the same pan for 1–2 minutes. Reheat mashed potatoes in the microwave in 60-second intervals stirring between each adding a pat of butter or splash of milk to restore creaminess. Reheat garlicky green beans in a skillet over medium heat for 2–3 minutes.

Dish: Vegetarian Stuffed Poblano Peppers with black beans corn & sweet potato
Instructions: Reheat in the oven at 375°F on a baking sheet for 15–18 minutes until heated through and pepper is tender. Or microwave covered for 2–3 minutes. Top with any reserved sauce or cheese and return to oven for 2 minutes if desired.
